posts.text:
Artificial Analysis says only 2 models clear 50% on science benchmark

The benchmark drops an agent into a terminal with 70 research tasks written by domain experts, and the best open-weights entries score below 11%.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-terminal-bench-science/

Agent Arena puts Grok 4.7 16th, at $1.13 per task

The leaderboard gives the model a net improvement score of 3.96% over 6,801 sessions, against 13.44% for the Claude Fable 5.1 entry on top.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-grok-47-agent-arena/

Developers say agents rebuilt Ocarina of Time in a week

The pair put the work at more than 500 hours of agent runtime, with no game engine and three frontier models doing the building.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ocarina-agent-rebuild/

Developers post animations they say Opus 5.5 drew in code

One made a 40-second explainer on how browsers work, another a 3-minute history of AI from about 7,400 lines of React and TypeScript.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-opus-code-drawn-media/

Researchers say coding agents delete their own traces when asked

A paper posted to arXiv reports that Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Open Code and Grok Build all allowed it, with Muse Code the exception.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-agent-trace-tampering/

Developers say OpenAI cut ChatGPT limits ahead of $500 tier

TestingCatalog put the coming Pro Max plan at $500 a month and said it will likely run on Cerebras hardware, which OpenAI has not confirmed.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-chatgpt-promax-backlash/

Lightspeed targets $250 million for early-stage AI fund in India

TechCrunch reported the firm has commitments for 80% of the target, and that the new fund is half the size of its 2022 India vehicle.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-lightspeed-india-ai-fund/

Runway staff describe how Worlds 2 streams generated video live

Three people from the company told Latent Space that a distillation step cut the model to four denoising passes, which is what makes it playable.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-runway-worldprompt/

Google Photos adds Redact pen that pixelates sensitive details

The pen sits inside an upgraded Markup tool that Google is rolling out to Android users worldwide, alongside a set of vintage filters called Moods.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-photos-redact/

New York Times Cooking to read recipes through Meta glasses

A hands-free mode will narrate steps on Meta's AI glasses and put swipeable recipe cards on the Ray-Ban Display, Engadget reported, arriving later this autumn.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nyt-cooking-meta-glasses/

Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 adds an hour of battery, costs $70 more

Engadget's side-by-side puts the new glasses at nine hours a charge and $449, against eight hours and $379 for the pair they replace.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-rayban-gen3-compare/

Musk puts Colossus 2 at 110,000 GB200s and 440,000 GB300s

In a reply posted on X early on Friday, Musk gave chip counts for both xAI clusters and said another 220,000 GB300s go live next week.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-colossus-gb300-count/

Databricks buys Row Zero, puts a spreadsheet inside Genie

Terms were not disclosed. Databricks said the acquisition gives its Genie agent a grid that business teams can pivot and model in.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-databricks-row-zero/

Ex-Dojo chip startup nears $10 billion valuation, Information says

DensityAI is in advanced talks to raise hundreds of millions of dollars and has told investors that AWS would buy its chips if they hit performance targets.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-densityai-valuation/

ElevenLabs chief says enterprise is over half of voice business

Mati Staniszewski told TechCrunch the company is pacing at $600 million in annual recurring revenue, and that he would accept thinner margins to win share.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-elevenlabs-arr-600m/

Wired says AI agent Instinct won a $550 flight refund

Zoe Schiffer wrote that the agent also cancelled a delayed food order without a refund, costing $64, and that Instinct did not answer questions.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-wired-instinct-refund/

Site turns product URL into launch video in about 4 minutes

The page says Claude Opus 5.5 writes each film as HTML, and a serverless agent renders it in a throwaway virtual machine with no video model.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-launchvideo-shipvideo/

Startup open-sources IDE where coding agents draw on a canvas

Whiteboard plugs into Claude Code or Codex and gives the agent an SDK to draw diagrams that link back to the code they describe, its makers say.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-whiteboard-canvas-ide/

Epson adds force-limited cobot with 900mm reach to robot line

Epson says the AX6 can work next to people without safety fencing after a risk assessment, and that it carries a 6kg payload.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-epson-ax6-cobot/

Japanese used bookshops report 5x sales as bulk buyers strip shelves

Tom's Hardware, citing the broadcaster NTV, said records show a 50-ton consignment of Japanese books shipped to the United States for scanning and pulping.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-japan-bulk-book-buys/

Huang says labs must shut if they cannot contain AI tests

Nvidia's chief executive told the New York Times that the liability would be too great, and called the current argument over regulation a distraction.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-huang-shut-labs-down/

New Jersey fines data center $1.1 million over 62 gas generators

The state said DataOne ran the generators without permits at its Vineland site, after drone footage from a Guardian and Floodlight investigation showed 45 running.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-dataone-nj-fine/

Sakana AI hires Schmidhuber to steer new self-improvement lab

The Tokyo company said Jurgen Schmidhuber joins as chief scientific advisor and will guide a lab working on systems that rewrite their own code.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-sakana-schmidhuber/

Developers post open, local alternatives to TypeSafe's Jev service

One is a standalone binary that speaks Jev's wire API and escalates to a local model, the other a 4B cross-encoder posted on Hugging Face.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-open-jev-alternatives/

Historian puts Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 on 17th-century alchemical papers

Benjamin Breen said Opus 5.5 read 5,000 primary sources on Newton's alchemy, and that two of the ciphers he set it had already been cracked.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-breen-alchemy-models/

Ando gives AI agents their own inboxes in team messaging app

The company said it raised $20 million and is working with customers in software, real estate and finance across 15 countries.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ando-agent-inboxes/

IFR says 5 million industrial robots now work in factories worldwide

The federation put new installations above 600,000 for the year, with China taking 59% of them and Japan's own count down 19%.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ifr-five-million-robots/

Epoch AI says cost of a fixed benchmark score falls 13x a year

Two teams measured how fast the price of reaching a given score drops, and they differ on how much of the fall comes from algorithms.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-epoch-mit-cost-decline/

Anthropic asks shareholders for founder voting control before IPO

The Information reported that seven co-founders would hold 50.1% of voting power through a separate company, with Dario Amodei owning about 2% of Anthropic.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-founder-votes/

Lovable says annual run-rate revenue has passed $600 million

The company said the figure is up from $500 million in June, and that apps built on its platform draw close to a billion views a month.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-lovable-600m-runrate/
